name: european_selection_readout_v1
selection_rule: Complete fixed-family readout only; no winner, threshold, retraining or deployment selected in this experiment. Report all three seeds; no best-seed selection.
primary_metric: equal-locality ADE percentage gain vs frozen old_stop; also all six motion baselines, source-training-selected baseline and protected floor
uncertainty: locality-level paired bootstrap, conditional model-selection evidence only; groups/seeds share localities and are not independent replications
easy_guard: CV-positive easy event uses each frozen producer training cutoff; report source-mean and worst-locality degradation, limit 2%, separate exact-zero CV harm
no_physical_claim: unsmoothed detector-track image pixels; annotation steps only, no metric/seconds/physical-safety/true-3D/foundation claims
